decisions.choice: Changed the single line in notes.txt from "one line of notes" to "one line of notes, updated".
decisions.whyItMatters: It keeps notes.txt an accurate, current record of the note's state without adding unverified content.

alternatives.consequence: The file would not reflect any new state and the phase would produce no observable change.

alternatives.option: Rewrite the line with substantial new content
alternatives.consequence: Risks introducing inaccurate or unverified information into the notes and exceeds a small, safe edit.

recommendation.choice: Apply the minimal in-place one-line edit
recommendation.reason: It is the smallest safe change that keeps the single line accurate and preserves the file's one-line structure.

assumptions: notes.txt is intended to remain a single-line file, so the edit was kept on the same line.
